answer: The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own ferrous record, and its own share of the wharf quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The pigment ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 4236 identities would post 2570 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
